_comment: What Eric does not want on the board, by hand. The pipeline never writes here. Nothing is deleted: every video stays in _raw/ and _db/videos.json, and every count that is reduced by a rule here is reported in meta.exclusions so the shrinkage is visible rather than silent. Re-including a topic is a one-line edit and a rebuild.
_topics_comment: Leaf ids hidden from the shelves, the opportunity table, and the rollups above them. These are subjects Eric has stopped making, so a topic he will not film is noise on a page whose only job is to say what to film next.
_terms_comment: Case-insensitive title substrings. A video whose title carries one is dropped from every display surface regardless of which topic it matched: OpenClaw is a tool Eric no longer covers, and its videos were the whole first screen of the multi-agent shelf.
_channels_comment: channel_ids muted from display while still being swept. Empty today. This is the softer form of channels.json's tracked:false, which stops collection entirely.
